classification.difficultyReason: Read labelled intercepts and identify where a supplied parabola is on, above or below the x-axis.

content.prompt: The parabola $y=x^2-2x-3$ is sketched on the right. By considering where the curve is in relation to the $x$-axis, write down the values of $x$ for which:

spec.description: Unshaded upward-opening parabola with arrowheads on both upper branches, positive-axis arrows, labelled x-intercepts −1 and 3 and y-intercept −3. No origin or vertex label.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph and its intercept labels remain visible in the question edition.

answer.worked: The curve meets the $x$-axis at $x=-1$ and $x=3$, so $y=0$ when $x=-1$ or $x=3$.
The curve is above the $x$-axis to the left of $-1$ and to the right of $3$. Hence $x<-1$ or $x>3$; the intercepts are excluded.
The curve is below the $x$-axis between its two intercepts. Hence $-1<x<3$; the intercepts are excluded.
